post.description:
The written draft for a claimed one (-> `draft_ready`, or straight to
`approved` when the organization sends first messages automatically). `409`
if it was cancelled meanwhile: drop it.

It went out (-> `sent`): logged on the lead as an outbound message, which
moves an uncontacted lead into conversation.
Writing or sending did not work (-> `failed`); a person can retry, rewrite or send it by hand.

Approves the draft, with any last edits (-> `approved`): the sending
workflow sends it on `channel`. A person only.

The person sent it themselves (from their own WhatsApp or mailbox, with
any edits): logged on the lead as sent (-> `sent`). Not once a workflow is
sending it. A person only.
Writes it again, with optional guidance (-> `requested`).

After a failure: writes it again (no draft yet) or sends the approved
message again. Also unsticks a send that never reported back.
Gives up on it (-> `cancelled`). Not while it is being sent.

EventBrief.description: Enough to put the exhibition's name at the top of a screen.

EventMembersUpdate.title: EventMembersUpdate
EventMembersUpdate.description: The full list of teammates working the show (replaces the previous list).

ExtractionContext.title: ExtractionContext
ExtractionContext.description:
Everything the extraction workflow should give its model with the card
and the recording: who we are, what we sell, where and when this was
captured, by whom, and the exact values the API accepts.

ExtractionResult.title: ExtractionResult
ExtractionResult.description:
What the extraction workflow (OCR on the card + speech-to-text and
extraction on the voice note) suggests. Every field is optional and is only
a suggestion: a person reviews and edits it before it becomes a lead, so
values here are not validated like a real lead (a phone may be messy).

IgnoredSenderCreate.title: IgnoredSenderCreate
IgnoredSenderCreate.description:
The intake workflow judged a sender not to be a buyer. Recording the same
sender again counts another message and keeps the latest reason/snippet.

IntegrationOrgRead.title: IntegrationOrgRead
IntegrationOrgRead.description: What the automation needs to know about an organization it works for.

LeadContext.title: LeadContext
LeadContext.description: Everything the lead page shows, in one call.

LeadFacets.title: LeadFacets
LeadFacets.description:
Counts for the filter chips. Each dimension is counted with every OTHER
filter applied (so picking a status does not hide the other statuses).

LeadNoteKind.title: LeadNoteKind
LeadNoteKind.description: Internal notes on a lead (never sent to the customer).

LeadProductSource.title: LeadProductSource
LeadProductSource.description: How a product got linked to a lead.

LeadProductsUpdate.title: LeadProductsUpdate
LeadProductsUpdate.description:
The full list of products this lead is interested in (replaces the list).
The first one becomes the lead's main product (`product_id`).

MentionedProduct.title: MentionedProduct
MentionedProduct.description: A product the buyer talked about, as said ("haldi powder, the 3% one").

key.title: Key
key.description: What cadence rules refer to, e.g. nudge-followup-1

MessageTemplateUpdate.title: MessageTemplateUpdate
MessageTemplateUpdate.description: `key` and `channel` are fixed once created: cadence rules point at the key.

OrganizationUpdate.title: OrganizationUpdate
OrganizationUpdate.description: What a tenant admin may change. slug / is_active / plan are operator-only.

OutreachApprove.title: OutreachApprove
OutreachApprove.description: Approve the (optionally edited) draft: a workflow sends it on `channel`.

OutreachDraft.title: OutreachDraft
OutreachDraft.description:
What the writing workflow posts: the message in both forms, in the
buyer's language, built only on what we actually know about them.

OutreachEdit.title: OutreachEdit
OutreachEdit.description: A person's edits to the draft before approving it.

OutreachManualSend.title: OutreachManualSend
OutreachManualSend.description: The person sent it themselves (from their own WhatsApp or mailbox).

OutreachStatus.title: OutreachStatus
OutreachStatus.description:
The personalised first message to a new lead, written by a workflow (AI)
from everything captured, approved by a person (or by the organization's
auto-send setting), and sent by a workflow or by the person themselves.

requested -> drafting -> draft_ready -> approved -> sending -> sent
failed (drafting or sending went wrong) and cancelled (a person gave up)
end it; a failed one can be drafted again or retried.

PlatformDeleteRequest.title: PlatformDeleteRequest
PlatformDeleteRequest.description:
Scheduling a deletion and confirming it both need the slug typed again
and a fresh authenticator code.

PlatformFreshCode.title: PlatformFreshCode
PlatformFreshCode.description:
A fresh authenticator code (or one recovery code) for what a session
alone may not do. The code used to sign in has been spent: use the next one.

Promise.title: Promise
Promise.description: Something WE promised the buyer ("send the price list by Monday").

ResearchResult.title: ResearchResult

ResearchStatus.title: ResearchStatus
ResearchStatus.description:
Lead research (public information + fit + score), done by a workflow.

requested -> processing -> completed | failed

ScoreBreakdown.title: ScoreBreakdown
ScoreBreakdown.description: Sub-scores, each 0..100. What the score is made of.

SimilarContact.title: SimilarContact
SimilarContact.description:
Not the same phone/email, but maybe the same person (similar name at the
same or a similar company, or their WhatsApp number is someone's phone).

WhatsAppMessageRead.title: WhatsAppMessageRead
WhatsAppMessageRead.description: The lead message a WhatsApp message id belongs to.

to.title: To
to.description: The recipient's number with country code

WhatsAppSend.title: WhatsAppSend
WhatsAppSend.description:
One message from the organization's WhatsApp number.

`text` is a free-form message (Meta accepts it only within 24 hours of the
customer's last message); outside that window use an approved `template`.
With `lead_id`, the message is recorded on the lead as an outbound
touchpoint (`log_content`, else the text) in the same step.

WhatsAppTemplate.title: WhatsAppTemplate
WhatsAppTemplate.description: An approved Meta message template. `body_params` fill {{1}}, {{2}}, ... in order.
